audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Achan, Ai defeat, lot exposure, confession, and Valley of Achor execution narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for corporate trespass, failed attack, thirty-six deaths, Joshua's lament, lot-based identification, Achan's confession, concealed plunder, execution of household and animals, stone heap, and collective-punishment concerns.

verses.restored: Children of Israel acted unfaithfully concerning devoted thing: Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, from tribe of Judah, took from devoted thing; and anger of YHWH burned against children of Israel.

familiar.text: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

modern.text: The Israelites, however, acted unfaithfully regarding the things devoted to destruction. Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart. So the anger of the LORD burned against the Israelites.

original.text: וַיִּמְעֲל֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מַ֖עַל בַּחֵ֑רֶם וַיִּקַּ֡ח עָכָ֣ן בֶּן כַּרְמִי֩ בֶן זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן זֶ֜רַח לְמַטֵּ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ מִן הַחֵ֔רֶם וַיִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, east of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, Go up and spy out land. The men went up and spied out Ai.

familiar.text: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Bethaven, on the east side of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country.  And the men went up and viewed Ai.

modern.text: Meanwhile, Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, “Go up and spy out the land.” So the men went up and spied out Ai.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מִֽירִיח֗וֹ הָעַ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר עִם בֵּ֥ית אָ֨וֶן֙ מִקֶּ֣דֶם לְבֵֽית אֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עֲל֖וּ וְרַגְּל֣וּ אֶת הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַֽיְרַגְּל֖וּ אֶת הָעָֽי

verses.restored: They returned to Joshua and said to him, Let not all people go up; about two thousand or three thousand men may go up and strike Ai. Do not weary all people there, for they are few.

familiar.text: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

modern.text: On returning to Joshua, they reported, “There is no need to send all the people; two or three thousand men are enough to go up and attack Ai. Since the people of Ai are so few, you need not wear out all our people there.”

original.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָיו֮ אַל יַ֣עַל כָּל הָעָם֒ כְּאַלְפַּ֣יִם אִ֗ישׁ א֚וֹ כִּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ יַעֲל֖וּ וְיַכּ֣וּ אֶת הָעָ֑י אַל תְּיַגַּע שָׁ֨מָּה֙ אֶת כָּל הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י מְעַ֖ט הֵֽמָּה

verses.restored: So from people about three thousand men went up there, and they fled before men of Ai.

familiar.text: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

modern.text: So about three thousand men went up, but they fled before the men of Ai.

original.text: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ מִן הָעָם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה כִּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּנֻ֕סוּ לִפְנֵ֖י אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָעָֽי

verses.restored: Men of Ai struck from them about thirty-six men and pursued them before gate as far as Shebarim and struck them on descent; heart of people melted and became as water.

familiar.text: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

modern.text: And the men of Ai struck down about thirty-six of them, chasing them from the gate as far as the quarries and striking them down on the slopes. So the hearts of the people melted and became like water.

original.text: וַיַּכּ֨וּ מֵהֶ֜ם אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעַ֗י כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשִׁשָּׁה֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֞וּם לִפְנֵ֤י הַשַּׁ֨עַר֙ עַד הַשְּׁבָרִ֔ים וַיַּכּ֖וּם בַּמּוֹרָ֑ד וַיִּמַּ֥ס לְבַב הָעָ֖ם וַיְהִ֥י לְמָֽיִם

verses.restored: Joshua tore his garments and fell upon his face to earth before ark of YHWH until evening, he and elders of Israel, and they put dust upon their heads.

familiar.text: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

modern.text: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown before the ark of the LORD until evening, as did the elders of Israel; and they all sprinkled dust on their heads.

original.text: וַיִּקְרַ֨ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ שִׂמְלֹתָ֗יו וַיִּפֹּל֩ עַל פָּנָ֨יו אַ֜רְצָה לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֤וֹן יְהוָה֙ עַד הָעֶ֔רֶב ה֖וּא וְזִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲל֥וּ עָפָ֖ר עַל רֹאשָֽׁם

verses.restored: Joshua said, Ah, Lord YHWH, why did you bring this people across Jordan at all, to give us into hand of Amorite to destroy us? If only we had been content and dwelt across Jordan!

familiar.text: And Joshua said, Alas, O LORD God, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

modern.text: “O, Lord GOD,” Joshua said, “why did You ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be destroyed? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֲהָ֣הּ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה לָ֠מָה הֵעֲבַ֨רְתָּ הַעֲבִ֜יר אֶת הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת אֹתָ֛נוּ בְּיַ֥ד הָאֱמֹרִ֖י לְהַאֲבִידֵ֑נוּ וְלוּ֙ הוֹאַ֣לְנוּ וַנֵּ֔שֶׁב בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּֽן

verses.restored: Please, Lord, what shall I say after Israel has turned its back before enemies?

familiar.text: O LORD, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

modern.text: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?

original.text: בִּ֖י אֲדֹנָ֑י מָ֣ה אֹמַ֔ר אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָפַ֧ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֹ֖רֶף לִפְנֵ֥י אֹיְבָֽיו

verses.restored: Canaanite and all inhabitants of land will hear and surround us and cut off our name from earth; and what will you do for your great name?

familiar.text: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

modern.text: When the Canaanites and all who live in the land hear about this, they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?”

original.text: וְיִשְׁמְע֣וּ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וְכֹל֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנָסַ֣בּוּ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְהִכְרִ֥יתוּ אֶת שְׁמֵ֖נוּ מִן הָאָ֑רֶץ וּמַֽה תַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה לְשִׁמְךָ֥ הַגָּדֽוֹל

verses.restored: YHWH said to Joshua, Rise for yourself! Why is this, that you fall upon your face?

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

modern.text: But the LORD said to Joshua, “Stand up! Why have you fallen on your face?

original.text: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ קֻ֣ם לָ֑ךְ לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה נֹפֵ֥ל עַל פָּנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Israel has sinned/misaligned, and they also crossed my covenant that I commanded them; they took from devoted thing, and also stole, and also deceived, and also put it among their own vessels.

familiar.text: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

modern.text: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed My covenant that I commanded them, and they have taken some of what was devoted to destruction. Indeed, they have stolen and lied, and they have put these things with their own possessions.

original.text: חָטָא֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְגַם֙ עָבְר֣וּ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אוֹתָ֑ם וְגַ֤ם לָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן הַחֵ֔רֶם וְגַ֤ם גָּֽנְבוּ֙ וְגַ֣ם כִּֽחֲשׁ֔וּ וְגַ֖ם שָׂ֥מוּ בִכְלֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Therefore children of Israel cannot stand before their enemies; they turn their back before their enemies because they have become devoted to destruction. I will not continue to be with you unless you destroy devoted thing from your midst.

familiar.text: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

modern.text: This is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies. They will turn their backs and run from their enemies, because they themselves have been set apart for destruction. I will no longer be with you unless you remove from among you whatever is devoted to destruction.

original.text: וְלֹ֨א יֻכְל֜וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָקוּם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיהֶ֔ם עֹ֗רֶף יִפְנוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י הָי֖וּ לְחֵ֑רֶם לֹ֤א אוֹסִיף֙ לִֽהְי֣וֹת עִמָּכֶ֔ם אִם לֹ֥א תַשְׁמִ֛ידוּ הַחֵ֖רֶם מִֽקִּרְבְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: Rise, sanctify people, and say, Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for thus says YHWH Divine of Israel: A devoted thing is in your midst, Israel; you cannot stand before your enemies until you remove devoted thing from your midst.

familiar.text: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

modern.text: Get up and consecrate the people, saying, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.

original.text: קֻ֚ם קַדֵּ֣שׁ אֶת הָעָ֔ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְמָחָ֑ר כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֵ֤רֶם בְּקִרְבְּךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֣א תוּכַ֗ל לָקוּם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶ֔יךָ עַד הֲסִירְכֶ֥ם הַחֵ֖רֶם מִֽקִּרְבְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall draw near in morning by your tribes; tribe YHWH takes shall draw near by clans, clan YHWH takes shall draw near by households, and household YHWH takes shall draw near man by man.

familiar.text: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

modern.text: In the morning you must present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD selects shall come forward clan by clan, and the clan that the LORD selects shall come forward family by family, and the family that the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.

original.text: וְנִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם בַּבֹּ֖קֶר לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָיָ֡ה הַשֵּׁבֶט֩ אֲשֶׁר יִלְכְּדֶ֨נּוּ יְהוָ֜ה יִקְרַ֣ב לַמִּשְׁפָּח֗וֹת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֞ה אֲשֶֽׁר יִלְכְּדֶ֤נָּה יְהוָה֙ תִּקְרַ֣ב לַבָּתִּ֔ים וְהַבַּ֨יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִלְכְּדֶ֣נּוּ יְהוָ֔ה יִקְרַ֖ב לַגְּבָרִֽים

verses.restored: It shall be, the one taken with devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all belonging to him, because he crossed covenant of YHWH and because he did disgraceful folly in Israel.

familiar.text: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

modern.text: The one who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.’” The Sin of Achan

original.text: וְהָיָה֙ הַנִּלְכָּ֣ד בַּחֵ֔רֶם יִשָּׂרֵ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ אֹת֖וֹ וְאֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֑וֹ כִּ֤י עָבַר֙ אֶת בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְכִֽי עָשָׂ֥ה נְבָלָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Joshua rose early in morning and brought Israel near by tribes, and tribe of Judah was taken.

familiar.text: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

modern.text: So Joshua arose early the next morning and had Israel come forward tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was selected.

original.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִשְׁבָטָ֑יו וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד שֵׁ֥בֶט יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: He brought clan of Judah near, and clan of Zerahites was taken; he brought clan of Zerahites near man by man, and Zabdi was taken.

familiar.text: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

modern.text: He had the clans of Judah come forward, and the clan of the Zerahites was selected. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward, and the family of Zabdi was selected.

original.text: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּלְכֹּ֕ד אֵ֖ת מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַזַּרְחִ֑י וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַזַּרְחִי֙ לַגְּבָרִ֔ים וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד זַבְדִּֽי

verses.restored: He brought his household near man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, from tribe of Judah, was taken.

familiar.text: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

modern.text: And he had the family of Zabdi come forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

original.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב אֶת בֵּית֖וֹ לַגְּבָרִ֑ים וַיִּלָּכֵ֗ד עָכָ֞ן בֶּן כַּרְמִ֧י בֶן זַבְדִּ֛י בֶּן זֶ֖רַח לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: Joshua said to Achan, My son, please give glory to YHWH Divine of Israel and give praise/confession to him; tell me, please, what you did; do not hide it from me.

familiar.text: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

modern.text: So Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make a confession to Him. I urge you to tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל עָכָ֗ן בְּנִי֙ שִֽׂים נָ֣א כָב֗וֹד לַֽיהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְתֶן ל֣וֹ תוֹדָ֑ה וְהַגֶּד נָ֥א לִי֙ מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אַל תְּכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּֽנִּי

verses.restored: Achan answered Joshua and said, Truly I have sinned/misaligned against YHWH Divine of Israel, and thus and thus I did.

familiar.text: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

modern.text: “It is true,” Achan replied, “I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I did:

original.text: וַיַּ֧עַן עָכָ֛ן אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אָמְנָ֗ה אָנֹכִ֤י חָטָ֨אתִי֙ לַֽיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְכָזֹ֥את וְכָזֹ֖את עָשִֽׂיתִי

verses.restored: I saw among spoil a good mantle of Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and one tongue/bar of gold, fifty shekels its weight; I coveted them and took them. Look, they are hidden in earth in midst of my tent, and silver beneath it.

familiar.text: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

modern.text: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.”

translation_notes: The narrative opens by assigning one person's act to all Israel, demonstrating a strong corporate-responsibility model.
The failed attack was launched on scouts' confidence with no recorded inquiry of YHWH, and thirty-six soldiers die before the hidden theft is identified.
The lot process narrows tribe, clan, household, and individual, but the text does not explain its mechanics or provide modern evidentiary safeguards.
Achan confesses taking a Shinar mantle, silver, and gold from Jericho's devoted spoil. His confession does not ethically justify punishment of uninvolved relatives.

Verse 24 explicitly brings Achan's sons, daughters, animals, tent, and possessions to the execution site. Verse 25 shifts between singular and plural, strongly suggesting the household and animals were destroyed with him, though interpreters debate details.
The killing of children and animals for one adult's theft is collective punishment and must be categorically rejected as modern justice.
The community that executed Jericho now punishes private appropriation of sacred-war plunder; this internal consistency does not make the larger herem system ethical.
Achor wordplay links Achan's troubling of Israel to the valley's name and later prophetic traditions of hope require separate cross-reference.
safety_note: Never use Joshua 7 to justify collective punishment, execution of children, destruction of families, trial by lot, coercive confession, killing for theft, or leader-controlled purges. Center transparent accountability, individual responsibility, reliable evidence, restitution where possible, and categorical protection of relatives, dependents, and animals from another person's wrongdoing.
